name: electron-builder
headline: GoFrame Skills: AI Code Generation for Go
short_description: GoFrame v2 provides development conventions and standards for building Go services and APIs. It is designed for developers looking to scaffold and manage their Go projects efficiently while adhering to best practices.
author: gogf

sections.overview:
GoFrame Skills is an AI skill designed to help developers and AI agents produce high-quality, production-ready code for the GoFrame framework. It provides comprehensive documentation covering core components including CLI management, configuration, logging, error handling, and database ORM, along with design overviews, usage guides, and best practices. The skill includes rich practical examples for HTTP services and gRPC microservices, enabling rapid project scaffolding. By embedding GoFrame conventions and standards, it empowers AI code generation tools to write code that adheres to framework best practices. This skill benefits Go developers building scalable services and microservices who want AI assistance that understands GoFrame architecture.
Scaffolding HTTP and microservice projects using `gf init`
Implementing business logic in the `service/` directory
Handling errors with `gerror` for better traceability
Reusing existing components to avoid duplicating code
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`$ npx skills add https://github.com/gogf/skills --skill goframe-v2`
`git clone https://github.com/gogf/skills`
sections.usage:
```
Using GoFrame v2, help me scaffold a new Go service for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] industry. The service should include [FEATURES] and follow GoFrame's best practices for project structure, dependency management, and API conventions. Generate the necessary commands, file structure, and initial code scaffolding.
```
Copy

```
# GoFrame v2 Project Scaffolding for Acme Corp's E-Commerce Platform
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
